login.heading: Welcome back.

hints.email: Enter your email and password to access the admin dashboard
hints.phone: Invited over Telegram? Enter your phone number and we'll send a code to your Telegram

login.phone_help: The number your admin invited. The code arrives in the Telegram chat that accepted the invite.
login.subtitle: Sign in to manage your café operations.

visual.hero_alt: 590st Cafe poster: iced soda, iced latte and iced americano in 590st cups
visual.caption: Crafted for your everyday ritual.

otp.heading: Enter your code
otp.sent_telegram: We sent a 6-digit verification code to your Telegram for {target}
otp.sent_email: We sent a 6-digit verification code to {target}

toast.customer_account: This is a customer account. Customer accounts can't open the staff dashboard — sign in with an admin or barista account.
toast.password_reset: Password reset. Log in with your new password.

errors.login_failed: Login failed. Check your credentials and try again.
errors.send_code_failed: Could not send a code to this number. Please try again.
errors.code_not_accepted: That code was not accepted. Check it and try again.

forgot.heading: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter the email of your staff account and we'll email you a 6-digit code to set a new password.
forgot.reset_intro: If an account exists for {email}, we sent it a 6-digit code. Enter it below with your new password.
forgot.password_hint: At least 8 characters, including an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol.

toast.code_resent: A new code is on its way. Codes from earlier emails no longer work.

errors.send_failed: Could not send a reset code. Please try again.
errors.resend_failed: Could not resend the code. Please try again.

steps.phone: Enter the phone number of your Telegram account.
steps.confirm: Confirm the login in your Telegram app.

telegram.not_configured: Telegram login isn't configured. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME to the bot's username and rebuild the dashboard.
telegram.footer: For admins and baristas invited through Telegram. Use the same Telegram account that accepted your invite.

errors.not_staff: This Telegram account isn't linked to a staff account. Use the Telegram account that accepted your invite, or ask your admin to send the invite again.
errors.login_failed: Telegram login failed. Please try again.

error_page.title: Access Denied
error_page.need_role: You need {role} role to access this application.
